On a tree, majority descent is a clean 2-core argument giving zero trapping; traps exist only through cycle closures in the ball, which occur with probability \u0398((log n)/n) per ball but with \u0398(n^{1/2}) independent frontier opportunities the total trap count is n^{1/2+o(1)} with a variance term of the same order, preventing convergence of P_n.
